user.title: HA Wecker – what do you want to add?

wecker.title: Set up alarm clock
wecker.description: The app reports its alarm list via webhook – it runs no background service and nothing polls it. The webhook address is generated now and shown afterwards in the diagnostic sensor "Webhook" and under "Configure"; that is the address for the app.

relais.title: Set up relay box
relais.description: Network address of the relay box, e.g. relaisbox.local or 192.168.1.60.

error.nicht_erreichbar: No relay box answers at this address.

abort.nicht_relaisbox: The discovered device is not a relay box.
abort.nicht_erreichbar: The discovered relay box does not answer.

error.nicht_erreichbar: No relay box answers at this address.

alarm_starten.name: Start alarm
alarm_starten.description: Runs a pattern (e.g. double flash) on the selected relays of the relay box until "Stop alarm" or until the duration has passed.

dauer.name: Duration
dauer.description: Seconds after which the pattern ends by itself. 0 = until "Stop alarm".

alarm_stoppen.name: Stop alarm
alarm_stoppen.description: Ends the pattern on the selected relays and switches them off.
